options: A partnership of capital-owner and worker with an agreed profit ratio
questions.explain: The investor bears the monetary loss and the worker bears the loss of time and effort.

questions.q: What ratio did Khadijah offer in the mudarabah?
questions.explain: Khadijah offered 50-50 to take her goods to Sham.

questions.q: Why does safar carry the meaning of unveiling?
options: Because it is in the desert
Because travel reveals a person's true character
questions.explain: Ask someone who has travelled with a person to judge his character.

questions.q: Who was the go-between who conveyed Khadijah's wish to the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Nafisah conveyed it politely and protected the dignity of both parties.

questions.q: Who delivered the proposal to Khadijah's family?
questions.explain: The proposal was delivered in verse, since Khadijah's father had died.

questions.q: What was the Prophet's SAW mahr to Khadijah?
questions.explain: The mahr is the husband's obligatory gift to his wife.

questions.q: What does the hadith advise about marrying off a daughter?
options: Marry her to one whose religion and character you are pleased with
questions.explain: Make the lawful easy and do not set excessive material expectations.

questions.q: The report of the proposal to Umm Hani before prophethood is an authentic report.
questions.explain: False. Scholars reject it and it cannot be accepted. Check the authenticity of sirah reports.

questions.q: Khadijah rejected wealthy suitors because character is everything.
questions.explain: True. Character matters more than wealth.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Possessor of two lights, the title of Uthman
Offer and acceptance in the marriage contract
The guardian who gives a woman in marriage

questions.explain: Ijab and qabul are offer and acceptance, the wali is the woman's guardian, walimah is the feast, and Dhun-Nurayn is Uthman's title.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW informed his uncles first before proposing. What is the lesson?
options: Respect family in matters of marriage
questions.explain: The proposal was brought by Abu Talib and Hamzah.
